segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yeah, thanks for making time, Dana. I wanted to walk through the order form for the 38 manager seats and 12 viewer seats, make sure the dates and billing match what you need.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yep. The seat mix is right. We’re trying to have the team live by September 16, so access on September 9 would be ideal for setup.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. I have the subscription start as September 9, twelve-month term through September 8 next year, and onboarding starting the week of September 9 with two admin sessions included.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. On price, the annual total you sent was $28,740. Is that with the annual payment discount already in there?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: It is. List comes out to $31,200 for that mix, and the pricing sheet gives us 8% for annual prepay, so $28,704. The extra $36 was the one-time sandbox fee, which I can remove because you’re not using it.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Good catch. So $28,704 flat, due net 30?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, net 30 from invoice date. The invoice can reference PO 44719, and I’ll set the bill-to as the Chicago office with the finance inbox you gave me.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Perfect. One more thing: our legal team asked for the data processing addendum to be attached, not just linked.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, it’s attached to the packet. No changes to the terms from what your team accepted in May, just included as a PDF with the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send the revised version without the sandbox fee and I can sign today.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Will do. You’ll have it in the next few minutes, and once it’s signed I’ll send the kickoff invite for September 10 at 11 Eastern.
